style: Photorealistic editorial photograph for a professional business blog. Natural daylight, calm and trustworthy mood, shallow depth of field, 35mm lens, realistic skin texture, clean modern office or workplace, cool blue and white tones.
people: When people appear, show one or two adults of varied backgrounds in neat business-casual clothing, with natural relaxed poses. No identifiable real people.
constraints: A single continuous photograph taken in one camera shot. No split panels, borders, collage or frames. No text, letters or numbers anywhere. No logos, signage, watermarks or readable screens. Natural hands and faces.

title.design: Corporate, clean and trustworthy. Place the title on the side of the image with the calmest background, over a solid or semi-transparent dark navy panel or gradient that does not cover any person's face. White bold Japanese gothic (sans-serif) typeface for the main title, and a smaller, lighter-weight subtitle in pale blue-white. If a small label is given, show it in a white rounded outline pill above the main title. A short light-blue accent line between the main title and the subtitle. Left-aligned, generous margins.
